title: A Stackelberg Game Framework with Drainability Guardrails for Pricing and Scaling in Multi-Tenant GPU Cloud Platforms
summary: Modern Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)-backed services must satisfy strict latency service-level objectives (SLOs) while controlling spare-capacity costs. In multi-tenant GPU cloud platforms, this trade-off is inherently dynamic because workload demand is endogenous; specifically, pricing shapes the submissions of heterogeneous tenants, which subsequently impact congestion and delay. We formulate the joint pricing-and-scaling problem as a large-population Stackelberg game problem, and we derive an explicit equilibrium demand map.
